The implementation now contradicts its docstring. The change to rounding (`round(seconds / 60)`) directly violates the documented behavior that "leftover seconds are dropped, never rounded up." The docstring even provides an explicit example: "119 seconds is shown as one minute" — with rounding, this would become 2 minutes.

While the tests do pass with this change, the docstring must be updated to reflect the new rounding behavior. This is especially important since the teammate emphasized the tests encode the HR-agreed spec — if the spec has indeed changed, the documentation should reflect that for future maintainers.

Please update the docstring to accurately describe the new rounding behavior before merging.
